guides.title: How We Review UK Online Casinos
guides.excerpt: The exact criteria we use to test, score and rank every UK casino — from licensing checks to bonus fairness.
body: Every casino featured on BestBritCasinoList is independently assessed against a fixed set of criteria. We never rank a site higher in exchange for commercial terms, and our scoring methodology is applied consistently across all brands.
Licensing comes first. We only list operators that hold a valid UK Gambling Commission licence, and we verify the licence number directly on the Commission's public register before publishing.

We then score each casino across weighted categories: game selection, bonus value and fairness, customer support quality, mobile experience and overall safety. Each category is tested using real accounts.
Bonus terms are reviewed in full. We look for clear wagering requirements, fair restrictions and transparent expiry windows — not just the headline figure.

Finally, we assess responsible gambling provision. Sites that make spend limits, time-outs and GAMSTOP self-exclusion easy to find score higher. Any operator that obstructs these tools is removed from our list.

guides.title: Understanding Wagering Requirements
guides.excerpt: Wagering requirements decide whether a bonus is actually worth claiming. Here's how to read them like a pro.
body: A wagering requirement (sometimes called a playthrough) is the number of times you must bet a bonus before any associated winnings become available to use. A '35x bonus' requirement on a £10 bonus means £350 of wagering.
Lower is better. A 20x requirement is far easier to clear than a 45x one, even if the headline bonus amount looks smaller. Always compare wagering, not just the percentage match.
Check what counts towards wagering. Slots usually contribute 100%, but table games and live casino often contribute far less — sometimes as little as 10% or nothing at all.
Watch for maximum bet limits while a bonus is active, and note the expiry period. A short window with high wagering can be unrealistic to clear.
Our golden rule: only claim a bonus you'd be comfortable playing through at your normal stakes. A bonus should add value, never pressure you to bet more than you intended.

guides.title: Safe & Responsible Gambling in the UK
guides.excerpt: Practical tools and free support services that help keep gambling fun and firmly under your control.
body: Gambling should always be entertainment, never a way to make money or escape problems. Every UKGC-licensed casino is required to provide tools that help you stay in control.
Set a deposit limit before you start. Daily, weekly and monthly limits can be configured in your account and act as a hard ceiling on spending.
Use reality checks and time-outs. A reality check reminds you how long you've been playing; a time-out locks your account for a chosen period, from 24 hours to six weeks.
If you need a longer break, GAMSTOP lets you self-exclude from all UK-licensed online gambling sites in one step, for six months, one year or five years, free of charge.
Free, confidential support is available any time from GamCare on 0808 8020 133 and via BeGambleAware.org. If gambling is no longer fun, these services can help — there is no cost and no judgement.

guides.title: How to Choose a Safe UK Casino
guides.excerpt: A practical checklist for picking a UKGC-licensed casino you can trust — licensing, bonuses, games and support.
body: Choosing a UK online casino should start with safety, not flashy bonus figures. Every operator we list holds a UK Gambling Commission licence, which you can verify on the Commission's public register.
Look for clear bonus terms. A strong headline offer means little if wagering, game restrictions or expiry windows are buried in the small print — always read the full terms before you claim.
Game variety matters too. A good site offers slots, table games and live casino options from reputable studios, with a platform that works smoothly on mobile and desktop.
Customer support should be easy to reach. Prefer casinos with live chat and a clear help centre so you can resolve questions quickly.
Finally, check that responsible gambling tools are easy to find: spend limits, reality checks, time-outs and GAMSTOP self-exclusion. If these are hard to locate, look elsewhere.
